name: Euphoria
source:
[spoiler] A daughter of Yuuto the Sage and Aselia the Eternal. By order of Rogas of Fate, the leader of Chaos Eternals, Euphoria is on her first mission in place of her parents. She is very lively and carefree despite being on her first mission alone. While Euphoria is very honest and innocent, she can very stubborn at times, never backing down on her decisions.

Euphoria suffers amnesia after saving the Brigade at the Magic World[spoiler]
translation:
[spoiler] A daughter of Yuuto the Sage and Aselia the Eternal. By order of Rogas of Fate, the leader of Chaos Eternals, Euphoria is on her first mission in place of her parents. She is very lively and carefree despite being on her first mission alone. While Euphoria is very honest and innocent, she can very stubborn at times, never backing down on her decisions.

Euphoria suffers amnesia after saving the Brigade at the Magic World[spoiler]
